text: Avantor priced its IPO on May 16, 2019 at $14 a share and closed its first day at $14.50. The stock fell to a low of $8.27 on March 18, 2020 in the pandemic crash, peaked at $44.01 on September 24, 2021, and closed the five years at $24.93 on May 20, 2024, 78.1% above the offer price. Its filings show steady profit growth and debt reduction, with the pandemic adding demand for testing and vaccine work.
